title: The Longest-Running Evolution Experiment
summary: Veritasium visits Richard Lenski's lab to explain the decades-long E. coli evolution experiment, which asks how repeatable evolution is and shows bacteria evolving to use a new food source.
why: Linked as the go-to overview of the long-running bacteria experiment whenever real-time evolution or resistance comes up.

quote.text: The longest-running evolution experiment uses bacteria and it has been running for more than 30 years.
